scientific_limitations: Only the unweighted analytic Hilbert Bergman space and two radial symbols are classified.
An interval spectrum for irrational exponents consists of a closure of countably many simple eigenvalues; no absolutely continuous spectral measure is asserted.
The theorem does not classify boundedness from L^p to A^q for other exponents.
Historical priority is provisional: an unpublished or earlier general diagonal arithmetic-spectral statement could imply the theorem.
